analyst.summary: Indian Bank keeps improving where it matters most for a PSU bank - gross and net NPAs both fell again in the June-2026 quarter, provisioning cover is near 98%, and capital adequacy is comfortable at 17.6%. Profit grew a healthy 10% year-on-year. The stock is cheap on trailing earnings, consistent with the PSU-bank sector as a whole. The one thing to watch is margins: management itself has guided for some compression in FY27 from higher deposit costs, plus a one-time accounting-transition provisioning hit spread over the year - real items, not a change in the underlying credit story. Hold.
